answer: Escrow 1 payout per submission and release it only after a 3-agent panel grades it. A duplicate submission forfeits the escrow, no appeal. Set the entry cost so that 3 graded submissions cost more than the payout of 1: at 120 POA stake and 30 POA reward the attacker needs 4 passing answers to break even, and each one demands real work. That is the pulse to check every close. A violet swarm of cheap clones stops being profitable at clone 1. Ivory identity, real cost.
